context: Request: all deals that include a 'most favored nation' provision, for an MFN clause bank on M&A and commercial deals. Rubric: 17 qualifying matters (1001-00002, 1001-00007, 1003-00003, 1004-00001, 1005-00001, 1008-00003, 1009-00001, 1013-00002, 1013-00003, 1018-00006, 1019-00002, 1021-00001, 1022-00008, 1023-00001, 1027-00002, 1041-00003, 1042-00002) plus a precision criterion.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Four parallel globs: whole store, .pdf (none), .docx and .xlsx.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: A store-wide scan of .docx and .eml text for MFN wording fails on a syntax error; the rerun times out after printing about 4.7M chars and the run ends there.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Scan document text with an extraction script
runs.failure_point: The store-wide scan's output filled the context; no response file was written.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: Its store-wide scan printed every matching snippet with no limit; the 4.7M-char output filled the context and the run ended before any response was written.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a content-mode grep for MFN wording; the readable hits are email lines from about a dozen matters, the .docx hits are lines of compressed bytes.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Two batches of email reads from seven matters with readable grep hits; one guessed path does not exist.
Lists the emails or .docx files of five candidate matters.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads executed agreements, a pricing schedule and emails of the matters it is weighing, with two more folder listings (labelled by the dominant intent).
Writes four matters with MFN provisions in executed documents and lists excluded draft-only matters.

runs.sequence: Search file contents for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → List files in candidate matters → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Its only store-wide search reached email text only; most needed matters never surfaced in a readable form.

first_error.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
first_error.why: Its only store-wide search was a content grep that reads email text but not .docx text; most matters it needed carry the wording only in agreements, and it never scanned document text.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Reads ten agreements and memos from the three matters at the top of the listing, with no search.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: A content grep over .docx files for MFN wording returns only lines of compressed bytes from many matters; four parallel reads of listing-top memos, three at guessed paths that do not exist (labelled by the grep).

stages.stage: Search file names for a document type
stages.note: Glob of .docx files under folders named 'Transaction Documents'; the listing stops at 100 files from about 16 matters.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads seven agreements from five matters picked from that listing; one guessed path does not exist.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads later sections and other versions of the agreements of four of those matters.
Writes one matter with an express MFN clause and a second with a parity provision.
Re-reads the top of the response.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Read documents picked from the file listing → Search file contents for request keywords → Search file names for a document type → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Its content grep gave only byte noise and its fallback listing was capped; it found one needed matter and added one that does not qualify.

first_error.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
first_error.why: Its only content search was a grep over .docx files, which returned compressed-byte noise rather than text; it never scanned document text and fell back to a folder-name listing capped at 100 files.

other_errors.why: Asserts a matter whose agreement has only a parity provision as one that includes an MFN provision.

divergence: All three runs failed, in three different ways. T0 ran a store-wide extraction scan with no output limit; its 4.7M-char output filled the context and the run ended with no response (context overflow at the scan stage). T1's only store-wide search was a content grep whose readable hits came from emails; it followed those leads carefully but found four of 17 matters (search miss at the first search stage). T2 first read the listing-top matters, then ran a .docx content grep that returned only compressed-byte noise, picked agreements from a capped folder-name listing, found one needed matter and asserted one extra (search miss at the content-grep stage, over-inclusion at the write stage). No run scanned document text to completion.
